تنتهكون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَهِكُونَ (tantahikūna) /tan.ta.hi.kuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# تُنْتَهَكُونَ (tuntahakūna) /tun.ta.ha.kuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
